messages.subject: Save warped shapes as .PLY files
parts:
Hello,

I have a question regarding the warpingmesh function to obtain negative and positive PC shapes. I was wondering if there was a way to save the warped shapes as a .PLY file.

Thanks in advance!

Ornella

messages.author: 46a88743ed7c8dd6
messages.subject: Re: Save warped shapes as .PLY files
parts: I have not found a way to do this in geomorph but there is a command in the Morpho package - mesh2obj(x, filename="name") - that saves it as an .obj.  There is also one that saves it as a .ply but I can't get that one to work for some reason.  I just convert everything in MeshLab anyways.
